result.summary: The page is largely intact; the explicitly allowed edge-clipped carousel/category items and bottom viewport cutoff were excluded. One minor content formatting oddity stands out on the lower pizza card.

issues.description: The pizza card in the lower 'Popular right now' area shows a badge labeled "-0%", which is a nonsensical discount value (negative zero percent) and looks like a formatting/data error rather than a real promotion.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0, or format real discounts as a meaningful value such as "-10%"; validate promo percentage rendering so signed zero is never displayed.
